description: Project-level references for brand campaign visuals, promotional imagery, social visual systems, and static plus dynamic campaign assets.

entries.why: A campaign reference for keeping one visual idea coherent across hero art, social crops, motion cutdowns, and landing-page modules.

compositions.title: One dominant campaign idea
compositions.study: The main image, type lockup, and message all support one memorable campaign claim.
compositions.reuse: Use when a product or brand campaign needs recognizability across channels.

compositions.title: Responsive crop family
compositions.study: The key visual survives square, vertical, wide, and motion formats because the focal point is protected.
compositions.reuse: Plan crop-safe zones before designing the final hero.

assets.notes: Create original imagery or licensed assets only.
assets.reuse: Use a consistent subject, color contrast, and message lockup.

assets.notes: Motion should preserve the same visual idea rather than introduce a separate language.
assets.reuse: Use short loops, caption-safe framing, and clear first-frame hierarchy.

motion.title: Short motion variant
motion.notes: Animate the reveal, crop, or type sequence while keeping the product or campaign promise legible.
motion.fallback: The first frame must work as a static promotional image.

implementation.notes: Useful for landing heroes, launch pages, social packages, and ad creative systems.

entries.why: A campaign reference for turning user data into culturally recognizable, shareable visual assets while keeping the brand flexible across genres, markets, social formats, and out-of-home moments.

compositions.title: Personal data as campaign creative
compositions.study: The campaign converts individual listening behavior into a branded story people want to publish themselves.
compositions.reuse: Use when a product has personal usage data that can become a respectful, opt-in visual artifact.

compositions.title: Social-first format family
compositions.study: Bold color, type, and shape systems survive stories, feeds, outdoor placements, and editorial coverage.
compositions.reuse: Design the smallest shareable unit first, then scale up to launch pages and public media.

assets.notes: Each asset needs strong first-frame hierarchy and enough brand signal after platform compression.
assets.reuse: Create templates that can ingest data while preserving brand rhythm and legibility.

assets.notes: Messaging works because it feels specific to the user while belonging to a global campaign.
assets.reuse: Let variables alter the story but keep the grammar recognizable.

motion.title: Sequential personalized reveal
motion.notes: Motion can turn metrics into a paced celebration rather than a static report card.
motion.fallback: Every animated card should export as a legible static share image.

interactions.title: Built-in distribution moment
interactions.study: The campaign succeeds because the visual asset and the sharing behavior are designed together.
interactions.reuse: Design campaign visuals alongside their sharing, download, and embed paths.

implementation.notes: Useful for year-in-review, usage recap, community benchmark, and personalized product storytelling.

capture.attribution: COLLINS Spotify case study and It's Nice That Spotify Wrapped identity coverage

project.title: Airbnb Aircover Miniature Motion Campaign
project.medium: product protection campaign film and still system
project.format: miniature world plus CG character campaign

entries.why: A strong reference for product reassurance that avoids dry UI explanation: handcrafted miniature spaces, CG characters, and scenario-based storytelling make an abstract service benefit feel tangible.

compositions.title: Service feature as small world
compositions.study: Aircover is visualized through memorable miniature stay scenarios rather than literal feature diagrams.
compositions.reuse: Use when a service promise needs emotional clarity and scenario proof.

compositions.title: Scenario set as campaign asset library
compositions.study: Different houses, characters, and landscapes create many campaign moments inside one art direction.
compositions.reuse: Build a modular world with repeatable props, framing rules, and character scale.

assets.notes: The miniature treatment makes protection feel warm, specific, and memorable.
assets.reuse: Translate abstract benefits into original scenes with clear stakes and a visible moment of relief.

assets.notes: Short scenes can become social cuts, landing modules, or campaign stills.
assets.reuse: Plan each scene to work as both a loop and a still frame.

motion.title: Lived-in miniature scene
motion.notes: Small character actions communicate story, scale, and service promise quickly.
motion.fallback: Use a still frame with one readable action and a protected focal point.

implementation.notes: Useful for product reassurance, insurance/protection concepts, travel, lifestyle, and service explainers.
